#4356: reject backtick paths that escape the skill root

fix/4356-backtick-escape-root · CodeRabbit thread on merge follow-up

What was broken

The structure test joined a backtick path to the skill root and only checked existsSync. A path like references/../../CLAUDE.md resolves under src/skills/, outside testing-e2e, and still looked like a hit if that file exists.

What changed

checkBacktickTarget resolves the path, then fails with a named message when the result leaves the skill root (ESCAPES_SKILL_ROOT). An escape probe runs on every test invocation.
